description: Tracks whose file size equals 10323804 bytes are kept along with larger ones.

c.request: Joining each track to its media type (dropping tracks with no matching media type) and using 10323804 bytes as the file-size threshold (`Track.Bytes`) to keep only the large files, for each media type name (`MediaType.Name`) give the media type name, the average list price per track (`Track.UnitPrice`), and the average of file size divided by track length (`Track.Bytes` ÷ `Track.Milliseconds`). Both averages should ignore missing values and be missing when there are none. Leave all values unrounded. Tracks whose file size equals 10323804 bytes are kept along with larger ones.
c.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

a.request: Joining each track to its media type (dropping tracks with no matching media type) and keeping only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is at least 10323804 bytes, for each media type name (`MediaType.Name`) give the media type name, the average list price per track (`Track.UnitPrice`), and the average of file size divided by track length (`Track.Bytes` ÷ `Track.Milliseconds`). Both averages should ignore missing values and be missing when there are none. Leave all values unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

d.request: For each media type name (inner-joining Track to MediaType so tracks without a matching media type are dropped), considering only tracks with Bytes >= 10323804 (equal to or larger than the threshold), return the media type name, the unrounded average of Track.UnitPrice, and the unrounded average of Track.Bytes divided by Track.Milliseconds, with both averages ignoring NULLs and returning NULL when there are no values.
d.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

b.request: For each media type name (tracks inner-joined to MediaType, keeping only tracks with Track.Bytes >= 10323804, i.e. equal to or larger than the threshold), return the MediaType.Name, the unrounded average of Track.UnitPrice, and the unrounded average of Track.Bytes divided by Track.Milliseconds, with both averages ignoring NULLs and returning NULL when no values exist.
b.sql: SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name
